001package com.streamconverter.examples;
002
003import com.streamConverter.StreamConverter;
004import com.streamConverter.command.IStreamCommand;
005import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SampleStreamCommand;
006import com.streamConverter.command.impl.SendHttpCommand;
007import com.streamConverter.command.impl.xml.XmlNavigateCommand;
008import com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule;
009import com.streamConverter.path.TreePath;
010import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
011import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
012import java.io.IOException;
013import java.io.InputStream;
014import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
015import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
016import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
017import org.slf4j.Logger;
018import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
019
020/**
021 * Complex XML processing pipeline demonstrating: HTTPS → XML parsing → DB lookup → API call → XML
022 * transformation → Response
023 *
024 * <p>This example showcases a real-world enterprise integration scenario where: 1. Large XML is
025 * received via HTTPS 2. Specific tag values are extracted as keys 3. Database lookup is performed
026 * using those keys 4. Backend API is called with the retrieved values 5. Returned XML is processed
027 * with reverse transformation 6. Final response is sent back to the original requester
028 */
029public class ComplexXmlProcessingPipeline {
030
031  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ComplexXmlProcessingPipeline.class);
032  private static final ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(10);
033
034  /**
035   * アプリケーションのエントリーポイント。複雑なXML処理パイプラインの例を実行します。
036   *
037   * @param args コマンドライン引数（使用されません）
038   */
039  public static void main(String[] args) {
040    logger.info("🌐 Complex XML Processing Pipeline");
041    logger.info("==================================");
042
043    try {
044      // Example 1: Basic pipeline demonstration
045      demonstrateBasicPipeline();
046
047      // Example 2: Full end-to-end processing
048      demonstrateFullProcessing();
049
050      // Example 3: Error handling and recovery
051      demonstrateErrorHandling();
052
053    } catch (Exception e) {
054      logger.error("Pipeline demonstration failed: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
055    } finally {
056      executor.shutdown();
057    }
058  }
059
060  /** Demonstrates basic pipeline structure */
061  private static void demonstrateBasicPipeline() throws IOException {
062    System.out.println("📋 Basic Pipeline Structure");
063    System.out.println("============================");
064
065    // Sample incoming XML with user request
066    String incomingXml =
067        """
068        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
069        <request>
070          <header>
071            <requestId>REQ001</requestId>
072            <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>
073            <source>mobile-app</source>
074          </header>
075          <body>
076            <user>
077              <userId>USR123</userId>
078              <sessionId>SES456</sessionId>
079              <action>getUserProfile</action>
080            </user>
081            <parameters>
082              <param name="includePreferences">true</param>
083              <param name="format">json</param>
084            </parameters>
085          </body>
086        </request>
087        """;
088
089    System.out.println("📨 Incoming XML:");
090    System.out.println(incomingXml);
091
092    // Step 1: Extract user ID for DB lookup
093    System.out.println("\n🔍 Step 1: Extract user ID for DB lookup");
094    IStreamCommand extractUserId =
095        XmlNavigateCommand.create(
096            TreePath.fromXml("request/body/user/userId"), new PassThroughRule());
097    processStep(incomingXml, extractUserId, "User ID extraction");
098
099    // Step 2: Extract session ID for validation
100    System.out.println("\n🔍 Step 2: Extract session ID for validation");
101    IStreamCommand extractSessionId =
102        XmlNavigateCommand.create(
103            TreePath.fromXml("request/body/user/sessionId"), new PassThroughRule());
104    processStep(incomingXml, extractSessionId, "Session ID extraction");
105
106    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
107  }
108
109  /** Demonstrates full end-to-end processing */
110  private static void demonstrateFullProcessing() throws IOException {
111    System.out.println("🔄 Full End-to-End Processing");
112    System.out.println("==============================");
113
114    // Large XML document simulation
115    String largeXmlRequest = generateLargeXmlRequest();
116
117    System.out.println("📊 Processing large XML request...");
118    System.out.println("Request size: " + largeXmlRequest.length() + " characters");
119
120    // Create comprehensive processing pipeline
121    IStreamCommand[] fullPipeline = createFullProcessingPipeline();
122
123    long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
124
125    try (InputStream inputStream =
126            new ByteArrayInputStream(largeXmlRequest.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
127        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
128
129      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(fullPipeline);
130      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
131
132      long processingTime = System.currentTimeMillis() - startTime;
133
134      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
135
136      System.out.println("\n✅ Processing completed!");
137      System.out.println("⏱️ Processing time: " + processingTime + " ms");
138      System.out.println("📤 Response size: " + result.length() + " characters");
139
140      // Show sample of result
141      String[] lines = result.split("\n");
142      System.out.println("\n📋 Sample response (first 10 lines):");
143      for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(10, lines.length); i++) {
144        System.out.println(lines[i]);
145      }
146      if (lines.length > 10) {
147        System.out.println("... (" + (lines.length - 10) + " more lines)");
148      }
149    }
150
151    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
152  }
153
154  /** Demonstrates error handling and recovery */
155  private static void demonstrateErrorHandling() throws IOException {
156    System.out.println("⚠️ Error Handling and Recovery");
157    System.out.println("===============================");
158
159    // Invalid XML for testing error handling
160    String invalidXml =
161        """
162        <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
163        <request>
164          <header>
165            <requestId>REQ002</requestId>
166            <!-- Missing closing tag for demonstration -->
167          </header>
168        """;
169
170    System.out.println("🔍 Testing error handling with invalid XML...");
171
172    try {
173      IStreamCommand xmlProcessor =
174          XmlNavigateCommand.create(
175              TreePath.fromXml("request/header/requestId"), new PassThroughRule());
176      processStep(invalidXml, xmlProcessor, "Error handling test");
177    } catch (Exception e) {
178      System.out.println("❌ Expected error caught: " + e.getMessage());
179      System.out.println("🔄 Implementing recovery strategy...");
180
181      // Recovery: Try to process what we can
182      String recoveredXml =
183          """
184          <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
185          <error>
186            <code>INVALID_XML</code>
187            <message>Request XML is malformed</message>
188            <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>
189          </error>
190          """;
191
192      processStep(
193          recoveredXml,
194          XmlNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("error"), new PassThroughRule()),
195          "Recovery processing");
196    }
197
198    System.out.println("\n" + "=".repeat(60) + "\n");
199  }
200
201  /** Creates a comprehensive processing pipeline */
202  private static IStreamCommand[] createFullProcessingPipeline() {
203    return new IStreamCommand[] {
204      // Step 1: Extract user ID from incoming XML
205      XmlNavigateCommand.create(
206          TreePath.fromXml("request/body/user/userId"), new PassThroughRule()),
207
208      // Step 2: Database lookup (simulated with sample processing)
209      new SampleStreamCommand("database-lookup-simulator"),
210
211      // Step 3: API call to backend service (simulated)
212      new SendHttpCommand("https://api.backend.example.com/user/profile"),
213
214      // Step 4: Process returned XML
215      XmlNavigateCommand.create(TreePath.fromXml("response/data"), new PassThroughRule())
216    };
217  }
218
219  /** Generates a large XML request for testing */
220  private static String generateLargeXmlRequest() {
221    StringBuilder xml = new StringBuilder();
222    xml.append("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n");
223    xml.append("<request>\n");
224    xml.append("  <header>\n");
225    xml.append("    <requestId>REQ_LARGE_001</requestId>\n");
226    xml.append("    <timestamp>2023-07-15T10:30:00Z</timestamp>\n");
227    xml.append("    <source>enterprise-system</source>\n");
228    xml.append("  </header>\n");
229    xml.append("  <body>\n");
230    xml.append("    <user>\n");
231    xml.append("      <userId>USR_LARGE_123</userId>\n");
232    xml.append("      <sessionId>SES_LARGE_456</sessionId>\n");
233    xml.append("      <action>bulkUserOperation</action>\n");
234    xml.append("    </user>\n");
235    xml.append("    <data>\n");
236
237    // Add many data elements to simulate large XML
238    for (int i = 1; i <= 1000; i++) {
239      xml.append("      <record>\n");
240      xml.append("        <id>").append(i).append("</id>\n");
241      xml.append("        <name>Record_").append(i).append("</name>\n");
242      xml.append("        <value>").append(Math.random() * 1000).append("</value>\n");
243      xml.append("        <status>active</status>\n");
244      xml.append("      </record>\n");
245    }
246
247    xml.append("    </data>\n");
248    xml.append("  </body>\n");
249    xml.append("</request>");
250
251    return xml.toString();
252  }
253
254  /** Helper method to process a single step and show results */
255  private static void processStep(String inputXml, IStreamCommand command, String stepName)
256      throws IOException {
257    try (InputStream inputStream =
258            new ByteArrayInputStream(inputXml.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
259        ByteArrayOutputStream outputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
260
261      StreamConverter converter = new StreamConverter(new IStreamCommand[] {command});
262      converter.run(inputStream, outputStream);
263
264      String result = outputStream.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
265      System.out.println("✅ " + stepName + " result:");
266      System.out.println(result.trim());
267    }
268  }
269}
